title: Antam Posts 240% Net Profit Surge in H1 2025, Driven by Nickel and Gold Sales, While Advancing Sustainability Roadmap
body: PT Antam recorded a 240% jump in net profit to Rp5.14 trillion in the first half of 2025, largely powered by a Rp3.53 trillion nickel profit and Rp49.54 trillion gold sales surge, with nickel production up 117% to 9.10 Mt and sales 144% to 8.20 Mt. The company also advanced its sustainability agenda, entering the commissioning phase of a SGAR alumina refinery, targeting a 15.8% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2030 and achieving a Social Return on Investment score above 2 and a TRIFR below the global average.
